# All-Star Renovations — Bathroom & Kitchen Remodeling in Central Arkansas

> All-Star Renovations is a licensed bathroom and kitchen remodeling contractor founded in 2014 by Thomas Pedersen and based in Conway, Arkansas. We specialize in grout-free shower systems, walk-in tubs, aging-in-place/ADA conversions, kitchen remodeling, and handyman services. Most projects install in 1-2 days with lifetime material warranties. Phone: (501) 504-3398. Service radius: 50 miles from Conway.

## Locations & Services
- [Conway, AR — Headquarters](https://allstarreno.com/locations): Our home base. Bathroom, kitchen, ADA, and handyman services.
- [Service Areas](https://allstarreno.com/locations): Greenbrier, Vilonia, Maumelle, Cabot, Sherwood, Little Rock, and surrounding communities.

## Services
- [Bathroom Remodeling](https://allstarreno.com/services): Walk-in shower installation, tub-to-shower conversion, walk-in tubs, ADA/Mobility conversions, grout-free systems. Premier $5,000-$7,499 · Signature $7,500-$9,999 · Designer $10,000-$12,500+.
- [Walk-In Showers](https://allstarreno.com/walk-in-showers): Grout-free All-Star Shower System with lifetime warranties.
- [Tub-to-Shower Conversion](https://allstarreno.com/tub-to-shower-conversions): Replace an existing tub with a modern walk-in shower in 1-2 days.
- [Aging-in-Place / ADA](https://allstarreno.com/aging-in-place-ada): Accessible bathrooms with safer entry and fixtures.
- [Walk-In Tubs](https://allstarreno.com/walk-in-tubs): Safer bathing options for seniors.
